atlases.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production SPRITE ATLAS for a richly illustrated hex strategy board game, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal square cells on a square canvas. No gutters, borders, labels or separators. Each cell is a full-bleed finely hand-painted miniature landscape, crisp realistic materials, 60-degree overhead view, no sky or horizon. Each cell fills all four corners with scenery; NEVER draw shaped tiles, hexagons, cutouts, floating platforms or margins. Main resource-identifying features must lie within the central 65 percent of each square for later hexagonal cropping. No words, text, icons, numbers, people, watermark or modern machinery. Rich, readable, consistent scale, natural daylight. COLUMNS left to right: SPRING, SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER. Each row repeats the SAME terrain composition with four clearly different seasons. No blending between the exactly equal cells. CLIMATE: ANDEAN high cultivated mountain valleys of South America, grassy terraces, grey-brown cliffs, distant snow only at extremely high mountain tips. No European pine forests. Spring moist growing season, Summer green early harvest, Autumn ochre-gold main harvest, Winter dry highland season with empty fields and straw-yellow grass, NOT blanket snow in valleys. ROW1 POTATO FIELDS: gently sloping terraces retained by old stone walls. Spring neat low broadleaf potato shoots. Summer dense green potato leaves and ONE small central woven basket holding a modest early harvest of clearly brown potatoes. Autumn largely browned low potato plants and several large centrally placed woven baskets full of brown potato tubers, visibly the MAIN harvest. Winter empty brown earthen furrows on stone terraces, no crops or baskets. ROW2 ALPACA PASTURE: a central small herd of recognizable long-necked Andean alpacas, white, brown, and cream, amongst tall highland grasses and grey rocks. Spring freshly shorn alpacas and rolled bundles of fleece in center. Summer fluffy healthy alpacas on lush green grass. Autumn cooler drier green-gold grass. Winter dry golden grass and fluffy alpacas without snow. ROW3 MOUNTAIN QUARRY: clearly central stepped pale-grey block stone quarry cut into Andean cliffs, square stone blocks and wooden hoist visible, highland coarse grass at edges, NO conifers. Mine remains open in Winter. ROW4 IRON MINE: central dark timber-framed mine entrance cut into grey-rust Andean rock, red iron veins, central wooden cart full of iron ore; sparse coarse highland grass, remains open in Winter. Generate exactly sixteen complete square scenes.
